target: GLM-5.2 explicit flashmla_kv decode on NVIDIA B200

measurement_identity.pairing: alternating reference/candidate in one process and one flexible-GPU wrapper invocation

attempts.hypothesis: Reduce the 128 partial outputs read by combine while retaining enough main-kernel parallelism.

baseline_evidence.observation: The combine rereads the same aggregate partial-output volume in both stock buckets, while 20 launched rows are no-ops.

exact_delta.dispatch: external candidate only; no production source changed

attempts.expected_effect: Lower combine DRAM reads and duration without changing the production ABI or synchronizing on host metadata.

correctness.coverage: strict eager comparison plus fresh-input CUDA-graph replay for M16 and M32

profiler_delta.interpretation: The reduction saves traffic, but less split parallelism slows the dominant main kernel by more than combine improves.

attempts.risk: A favorable single graph median can mask a repeated eager regression when the latency distribution is wide.
attempts.rollback: Unset GLM52_FLASHMLA_NUM_SM_PARTS and use stock metadata; production dispatch was never changed.

attempts.hypothesis: Rotate the four raw FP8 rows consumed by each dequant group across shared-memory banks to reduce the measured excessive wavefronts and bank conflicts.

exact_delta.layout: four 512-byte rows per group plus 16-byte padding

attempts.expected_effect: Reduce shared-bank replay in the main kernel without changing logical row, scale, mask, output, or combine semantics.

correctness.root_cause: The 2064-byte stride advances the second destination from aligned 0x24000 to misaligned 0x24810, violating 128-byte shared-address alignment.

paired_timing.reason: The correctness gate failed before timing.

graph.reason: A known-invalid device binary was not captured.

profiler_delta.reason: No candidate NCU or NSYS collection is valid after a correctness fault; offline ptxas resources only are preserved.

attempts.risk: TMA destination alignment is stricter than the original source assertion; static mapping and successful compilation cannot validate an async-copy layout.
attempts.rollback: FlashMLA parent 05e26647fe840b8baedae486c2d86d5ce4efeb7c; stock production namespace and binary remained active.
